title: Caller-selected in-cluster artifact destination
description: The ci-skills storage wrapper. Native Kubernetes volumeSource fields pass unchanged to Kubernetes.

namespace.description: Existing namespace in which the tool Pod accesses the selected volume.

volumeSource.description: Unchanged native Kubernetes VolumeSource, such as persistentVolumeClaim, nfs or emptyDir.

mountPath.description: Absolute mount point inside the Pod.

artifactPath.description: Exact absolute final artifact filename below mountPath; never a laptop path.

buildOutput.description: Produce directly at artifactPath, or on owned scratch then copy and verify artifactPath.
